description: IPC/CrPC/Evidence Act -> BNS/BNSS/BSA. DEVELOPMENT_ONLY: transition rows cite the repeal-and-savings sections; mapping rows are algorithmic candidates (eval/tools/succession_matcher.py) awaiting a named legal editor.

payload.scope_note: Offences committed before 1 July 2024 are dealt with under the repealed Indian Penal Code (BNS s.358). Legal editor to confirm.

Appeals, applications, trials, inquiries and investigations pending on 1 July 2024 continue under the Code of Criminal Procedure (BNSS s.531(2)). Proxy: date the proceeding was instituted. Legal editor to confirm.
Proceedings pending before 1 July 2024 continue under the Indian Evidence Act (BSA s.170). Proxy: date the proceeding was instituted. Legal editor to confirm.
